paletteAndSample:
Edit this approved Chinese typography still with ONLY TWO changes.
1. Replace the five-character sample title with the exact four-character title "音乐影像". Do not include 精选作品集 anywhere. Design the new characters in precisely the same approved geometric language: very thin charcoal outlines, transparent flat parallelogram/triangle planes, irregular folded intersections, a few extended construction lines, and open negative spaces. Correct readable Chinese characters. Maintain the same restrained graphic/architectural depth; do not add calligraphic curves or 3D rendering.
2. Change the pink/magenta tinted planes to a VERY PALE neutral-to-warm RED. Think diluted vermilion/rust red through transparent glass: underlying pigment around #C7473B at 10–15% opacity over white, with green and blue nearly equal and blue slightly LOWER than green. Absolutely no pink-purple, magenta, lavender, peach-orange, saturated red, or dark red. It should read as a breath of light red, never a strong color.

Preserve all other qualities: pure white background, extremely light cool-white/gray front planes, hairline gray/charcoal edges, translucency, asymmetrical geometric decomposition, no chunky extrusion, no bevel, no shine, no glow, no surface or cast shadow. Wide landscape still with abundant white margins. No extra text or labels. This is a surgical refinement of the approved subtle flat geometric glass artwork, not a new style direction.
glyphCorrection:
Correct ONLY the Chinese letter anatomy in this existing pale-red glass typography image. Keep exactly the current delicate planar style, pale warm red tint, cool almost-white planes, thin charcoal contour lines, white background, overall placement, flat architectural drawing, airy depth, and quiet refined mood.

The intended exact text is 音乐影像. Read left to right:
1 音 — top 立 and bottom 日 (the bottom box has its middle horizontal).
2 乐 — simplified Chinese character 乐. This was rendered incorrectly like 选. Redraw it as the CORRECT 乐: a short upper-left slanted stroke, a folded left stroke, a central vertical with hook, a left-falling lower stroke, and a right dot. NO 辶 walking radical, NO 先, NO long bottom enclosing stroke.
3 影 — left 景 and right 彡 (three diagonal strokes). Keep its correct form.
4 像 — left 亻, right 象. This was rendered incorrectly like 集/隹. Redraw the right side as the CORRECT 象 radical, with its top angled head, small central box, long descending curved hook represented with angled planar segments, and the spreading diagonal strokes below. NO 隹 bird radical, NO stacked horizontal comb, NO 木 tree radical.

The artistic planes may decompose the strokes, but the actual Chinese characters must be correct, recognizable 音乐影像. Do not invent characters, and do not preserve the incorrect old second/fourth glyphs. No explanatory labels, no additional words. No shine, no bevels, no saturation increase, no style change.
